As shown in Fig. 5a, our observations indicate that the MMM electrode had a lower electrical resistance at the interface than the Ref electrode. This can be attributed primarily to the nonuniform distribution of the binder, which results in longer and more complex electron pathways. In contrast, HML exhibited the lowest interfacial resistance. This is owing to the insuffi­ ciency of binders near the interface, which allows for a smooth electron transportation from the current collector to the bottom layer of the electrode.
